data.gender_notes: Sahidul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sahi means 'excellent, perfect' and Dul means 'beloved'. The name Sahidul means 'perfect and beloved warrior'. The name Sahidul carries the meaning “Brave Warrior” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali, Hindi. Parents who choose Sahidul usually hope their child will grow to embody brave warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name resonates with the energy of courage, bravery, and strength. It is a name that inspires one to face challenges with confidence and determination.
data.etymology: Sahidul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sahidul total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

The prefix "Sahi" signifies an individual who embodies these qualities, while "Dul" or "warrior" reinforces the image of someone who is brave and steadfast in their actions and beliefs.

He was a key figure in the Indian National Army (INA) and played a crucial role in the INA trials after India's independence.
